complicacoes.texto: Duplicate Damsel still carries the memory of the death of one of her duplicates at the hands of Computo. It haunts her in ways others can never understand. ALLIES Duplicate Damsel can count on her fellow Legionnaires and her students from the Legion Academy, but most of all on her husband, Chuck Taine (Bouncing Boy). Of course, she is also her own greatest ally, able to outnumber most foes all by herselves!
